limits.why: the stride changes no parameter, so a candidate's weights equal its incumbent's byte for byte in size; its W8I arena at the runtime's default tile must not exceed the incumbent's; its shape's box estimate (#85 without prefetch credit, 333 and 444 MHz) must stay under the tier's time ceiling (Small < 1 s, Normal < 2 s, Large < 3 s)

S16.shape: s_w100v4987 with ds22 (train/model.py stage_strides(16): the 2-row stage's DS block at stride (2, 2))

N12.shape: n_w150v5631 with ds3w3 (stage_strides(12): the 4-row stage's DS block at stride (2, 3); max width 1,020)

probe.what: 1,000 steps of each pretrain configuration (2 seeds each, 8 at once through heavy.sh, 5 threads), eval/stride16_run.sh TIER STRIDE pre SEED with STRIDE16_PROBE=1 (no development evaluation)
probe.vocr5_probe: Small 0.38, Normal 0.54, Large 0.75 s per step (VOCR5's probe, 8 at once)
probe.decision: VOCR5's lengths are kept: the probe projects 14-16 h per pretrain

code.model: train/model.py TinyVNOCR(stride=8|12|16) via stage_strides(): 16 runs the 2-row stage's downsampling DS block at stride (2, 2), 12 the 4-row stage's at (2, 3); the state_dict is a stride-8 model's; checkpoints record 'stride' and 'max_width' (absent = 8, 1024)
code.train2: --stride sets the CTC input lengths (ceil(w / s)), the label-fits-frames filter (train/train.py ctc_ok at the stride: a line whose characters + adjacent repeats exceed its frames is dropped at load, as at stride 8 today), the augmentation's minimum width ((frames - 1) * s + 1), the width clamp (1,024; 1,020 at 12) and the batch padding; kd= sources are refused at strides other than 8
code.export: build_blob's max width defaults to the largest multiple of the stride up to 1,024 (export.py default_max_width); a max width that is not a multiple of the stride is refused
code.runtime: runtime/vocr.c: op width strides up to 3 (a stride-12 model); the default tile (vocr_opts.tile_frames = 0) is 4 frames, or for a stride over 8 the frames within 32 input columns (2 at 12 and 16), so Rubi's zeroed options give a coarser model the smaller arena (export.plan_arena mirrors it); every stride-8 blob runs bit for bit as before
code.tests: tests/test_stride16.py; runtime/tests/parity.py --fixture --stride 16 / 12 in make check (bit-exact against vocr_ref, PyTorch tolerance, tile invariance, VOCR_INVERT, arena = plan_arena)

data.rule: exactly VOCR5's (eval/vocr5_protocol.json 'data'), read through its pins, unchanged
data.checked: eval/stride16_run.sh checks the vocab's sha256, every synthetic shard against its manifest and every pool against eval/vocr5_pools.sha256 before a run (sha256sum -c printed OK at freezing)

recipe.pretrain: VOCR5's (eval/vocr5_protocol.json recipe.pretrain) plus --stride: from scratch, batch 96, lr 2e-3, warmup 1,000, cosine to 0.05, wd 0.01, EMA 0.999, the arm's steps, seed S, 5 threads, eval every 4,000 (logged only), --keep-evals; recipe C for Small (nv 0.5 + s2 0.25 + s3 0.25), M for Normal and Large (nv 0.45 + s2 0.225 + s3v3 0.225 + s4v5631 0.1); the final EMA checkpoint is the pretrain
recipe.fine_tune: VOCR5's arm F (the arm VOCR5 adopted at every tier) plus --stride: 15,000 steps, batch 96, lr 1.2e-3, warmup 500, cosine to 0.05, wd 0.01, EMA 0.999, kd 0, from the arm's pretrain of the same seed, eval every 2,500 (logged only), --keep-evals; synthetic half 0.5 (the recipe's sources at half weight, fa=0.15 on nv and s2), real half 0.5 from VOCR5's pinned pools with eval/vocr5_ft_sources.json's weights, fa=0.3 on the ink sources and every GRAD source with its refined copies; the final EMA checkpoint (ckpt_step15000.pt) is the run. VOCR5's arm P is not run (F was resolved better at every tier)
recipe.script: eval/stride16_run.sh TIER STRIDE pre|F SEED through HEAVY_SLOTS=12 $HERD/heavy.sh (5 threads), from a detached runner worktree tagged stride16-runner-<sha>; outputs $HERD/shared/artifacts/stride16/runs/
recipe.order: the slowest first: the 8 pretrains at once (Large, Normal 16, Normal 12, Small), at most 8 stride16 runs at once (fewer if head-gate or head-2level need slots: they share the box); each pair of fine-tunes when its pretrains are done
recipe.failures: a pretrain that dies after its first checkpoint resumes from ckpt_last.pt (train2's resume reseeds the batch stream; recorded); any other run that dies is deleted and restarted from scratch with the same arguments; every restart or resume is reported

estimates.rule: every A9 figure is an estimate and labelled one; sizes and arenas are exact (train/export.py, the C runtime). The method is VOCR5's (eval/vocr5_protocol.json estimates.rule (a)): vita/a9_layers.py measure at ocr-speed's 8d21908 on ocr-speed's 24 development lines of 60-100 stride-8 frames (pack dev_res.bin), --topk 8, random-init blobs of the exact shapes, the runtime copies of main before #85 ('main') and of #85 ('#85'; with --no-pld for '#85 no-PLD', the basis the tiers are sized on), every phase's high bound scaled by 1.000676 (VOCR3-H15's console rate, 4,941.7 us per frame at an assumed 333 MHz, the owner's 5.0-5.2 ms per CTC frame), 444 MHz by a9_layers' analyse at 444; per stride-8 frame = the 24 lines' total over their 1,609 stride-8 frames; a nominal 3-line box = 240 stride-8 frames + 0.1 s for the finder; a real box = 89 stride-8 frames (text-stats-boxes, the owner's Vita captures through Rubi's finder); the stride-12 shape runs on copies of the same runtimes with op strides up to 3; the tile is the runtime's default (2 frames for stride 12 and 16, 4 for the stride-8 incumbents)

cohorts.rule: exactly VOCR5's (eval/vocr5_protocol.json 'cohorts'): tv = teacher_val_dev.npz (959 lines, 101 VNs), dn = devnative's four *_dev.npz files (765 crops, 34 VNs), wd = the whole-dialogue regions of $HERD/shared/artifacts/vocr5-train/cohorts/{tv_dlg,dn_dlg}.pkl at base, +4 and +8 px, every file checked against VOCR5's sha256 before a score

score.rule: exactly VOCR5's (eval/vocr5_protocol.json 'score'): the C runtime W8I; tv and dn by eval/synth3_ablation.py score (views rv and rvn), wd by eval/finder_tighten.py score --cohorts $HERD/shared/artifacts/vocr5-train/cohorts --cohort tv_dlg --cohort dn_dlg --flags default (the C GRAD finder with flags 0 and with the refinement); dialogue only (names a secondary column); dev score = 0.25 tv + 0.25 dn + 0.5 wd in CER points (eval/stride16_select.py, a copy of eval/vocr5_select.py's scoring)
score.incumbents: VOCR5-S / N / L are scored once with the same runner on the same cohorts, under their protocol names

floor.definition: for a row (a fixed development line, or a whole-dialogue unit: a region read in one finder mode at one variant) NR = the reference's characters + adjacent repeated characters (eval/metrics.norm; a unit sums its reference lines), T_s = its CTC frames at stride s as the runtime cuts them (a fixed line: ceil(q / s) with q the runtime's resized width of the stored crop; a unit: the sum over the C finder's lines of the same); a row is BELOW THE FLOOR at s when T_s < NR (no model can read it exactly) and TIGHT when T_s < 1.25 NR
floor.tool: eval/stride16_floor.py build (model-independent; the C finder and its twin agree on every case)
floor.file: eval/stride16_floor_dev_20261023.json (a copy of $HERD/shared/artifacts/stride16/floor/floor_dev.json: ids, frame counts and hashes only)
floor.unit_caveat: a whole-dialogue unit's ratio is a proxy (its lines are recognised one by one, but their reference is the region's): a unit whose finder misses or merges lines also looks short of frames (36 units are below the floor already at stride 8)
floor.training: train2 drops a training line whose label does not fit its frames at the run's stride (ctc_ok), as at stride 8; the counts per pool are reported

decisions.bootstrap: paired, stratified VN-cluster: 10,000 resamples (numpy default_rng); tv, dn and wd resampled independently with seeds 0, 1, 2 as in VOCR5; the fixed-line tight stratum (tv's and dn's tight dialogue lines pooled, one cluster per VN) seed 3, the whole-dialogue tight stratum seed 4; the difference is the mean over the arm's two seeds of (candidate - incumbent), in points
decisions.rule: an arm is adopted iff (a) wd: the interval does not lie entirely above 0; (b) tv and dn: neither interval lies entirely above 0; (c) the lines below the CTC floor are handled: neither tight stratum's interval (at the arm's stride) lies entirely above 0 (a stratum of fewer than 5 VN clusters cannot be resolved and passes, flagged), and the floor rows' counts and CERs are reported; (d) both runs are within the tier's limits
decisions.normal: Normal decides N16 first; N12 is decided only if N16 is not adopted (both are trained and reported)
decisions.commit: each decision file is committed and pushed before its tier's selection

selection.rule: per tier, the adopted arm's run with the lowest dev score (ties at 5 decimals to the lower seed); otherwise the incumbent stays
selection.reported: every run with every component, the names column, the floor strata, per-platform rates, bytes, arena and the estimates
selection.commit: the three selections are committed and pushed before the locked report

vertical.V16: run only if S16 is adopted (VOCR5-V started from VOCR5-S's selection): VOCR5-V's recipe (eval/vertical_protocol.json 'VOCR5-V'.recipe and data, unchanged) with --stride 16 and --init the selected S16 run's ckpt_step15000.pt, seeds 1 and 2; the run is its last checkpoint
vertical.score: eval/vertical.py columns on the vertical development set (eval/vertical_protocol.json 'sets' dev, amendment 1's pins): VN dialogue CER on fixed column crops (primary) and manga, C runtime W8I greedy; series-cluster bootstrap (manga: page) as eval/vertical.py diff, 10,000 resamples, seed 0
vertical.rule: V16 replaces VOCR5-V (v0.3.2-vertical.1) iff the VN interval of the mean over seeds of (V16 - VOCR5-V) does not lie entirely above 0, manga's does not either, and the tight columns (T_16 < 1.25 NR on the fixed column crop) are not resolved worse; the seed with the lower VN CER is selected

head_gate: if head-gate's gate (#117 item 1, feat/head-gate) is on main when the selections are committed, a gate is trained for each adopted model with head-gate's own training script and recipe (its protocol's 'training' data and threshold rule), and the composition is reported on the development cohorts (CER change, skip rate, est. ms per box); it changes no stride16 selection. If the gate has not landed, this is left to head-gate and stated

locked_report.when: once, after the three selections are committed and pushed
locked_report.arms: VOCR5-S / N / L (the incumbents) and each tier's best run of every arm by development score (S16, N16, N12, L16; an arm that was not adopted is report only)

sets.fixed lines: vita-test and psp-test through the scalar C W8I runtime, console polarity primary, native also; dialogue (no 'name' style) primary, all text and names also
sets.whole dialogue: each region at base, +4 and +8 px with the C GRAD finder and its refinement
sets.CLANNAD: owner-drive-ingest's frozen references through eval/clannad_refs.py's extra-arms path (suffix stride16, one attempt), dialogue primary, page bootstraps
sets.deployed decode (report only): beam 8 + the overlay's 1 MB LM at docs/ctc-lm-decode.json's settings

locked_report.statistics: candidate - incumbent per tier, paired bootstraps (10,000 resamples, seed 0) over lines and VN clusters (pages for CLANNAD)
also: blob bytes, W8I arena at the default tile
est. ms per nominal and per real box at 333 and 444 MHz (estimates)
the floor strata of the protected lines (report only)
locked_report.rule: it decides, tunes and drops nothing; an attempt record refuses a second read
